scope: Historical Blue 201MP A/D diagnostic on physical Android Chrome. Owned-page CDP captures, not native screen captures or timed performance trials.
settleRule: Camera at rest, sufficient detail, and more than 1500 ms without repaint; 25000 ms timeout.
comparison: Maximum absolute per-channel RGB difference against the same-run baseline, not an independent golden reference.
limitations: Only three checkpoints settled in both arms. Matching pixels do not establish absolute fidelity, source identity, or transient blank/stale/tier-pop behavior.
Prepared-build identities were caller-supplied; the challenger is the reconstructed build, not the historical commit object.
The captures and full raw report are not published.
